enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Sigh. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Move arm. Adjust blanket. Remain sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up and swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen and turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out pan and place on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan and stir. Turn off induction cooker. Take out plate. Put eggs on plate. Open drawer and take out fork. Close drawer. Pick up plate and fork. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat eggs and drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate and fork. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and fork.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put stethoscope in bag. Put notebook in bag. Put pen in bag. Close bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Push door. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to patient room 2. Perform similar tasks. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Walk back to nurse station. Update records.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter home. Close door.

Walk into kitchen and turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Chop vegetables and chicken. Take out pan and place on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil, chicken, and vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Put food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner and drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Sweep floor. Put broom away. Take out trash. Tie trash bag. Walk to outside bin. Throw trash bag in bin. Walk back inside. Wash hands. Dry hands.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Turn off light. Lie down. Close eyes.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Sigh. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Move arm. Adjust blanket. Remain sleeping.
